# Section 9 flag word

Word outside the DbgSup range that section 9 reloads from flash at every power-on; OMKit's once-per-boot flag.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0x615ee7c0` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

Reloaded at every real start, so a value written here survives a cancelled power-off but not a new boot. That lets a loader tell the two apart. Writing here is an exception to keeping state out of the loaded image.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)): Filler word in the section 9 tail, outside the protected range. Source: [OMKit loader patch for OM-5 Mark II 1.1](../sources/omkit.patch.md).
- **Physical camera** ([OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)): Written on the camera; a quick lever off-on did not start core twice. Source: [OMKit loader patch for OM-5 Mark II 1.1](../sources/omkit.patch.md).
